data.what_done: Identified why subagent display appears correct only sometimes when navigating subagent sessions.
data.approach_taken: Traced the prompt UI’s agent selection and compared it with agent mode filtering.
data.challenges_faced: Reconciling the intermittent nature required comparing subagents configured as mode=all vs mode=subagent.
data.how_solved: Verified the UI filters out mode=subagent from its selectable list, so only mode=all subagents can display correctly.
data.reasoning: The prompt bar is driven by local agent state, which excludes subagents; if the subagent is mode=all (default), it appears correctly, otherwise the UI shows the last primary agent.
next_steps: Decide whether to let subagent sessions override the prompt bar with the session’s agent.
Audit subagent configs that are implicitly mode=all vs explicitly mode=subagent.
